items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC-1..AC-9 each map to a test or a doc line; AC-5/AC-9 doc-only by decision.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unreadable loop state never blocks the resolver; malformed marker reads as none; verifier skew is an ask note, an internal TypeError still propagates to the gate-error path.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new input surface; override provenance limit stated exactly; raw claim not gated is disclosed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Red-first for behaviour changes (cap, archived split, version default, type check); real archive_split used, one subprocess CLI test, in-process tests for coverage.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra small JSON read per single-session-next; inspect.signature once per build gate.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: build_checks.py shrank 461->454; all touched modules under 300 LOC; leaf build_split module mirrored and pinned.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: archive_split -> validators/verifiers round-tripped with the real producer; loop_state gateTerminal written by apply and read by resolver in one test; ask_human JSON read through the real CLI subprocess.
